name: @three-studio/editor
description: Editor UI: React shell, dock layout, viewport tooling, inspector.
//sideEffects: The stylesheet is the side effect: `import '@three-studio/editor/styles.css'` must survive tree shaking.
//build: The stylesheet is compiled here rather than shipped as Tailwind source: a consumer would otherwise need Tailwind, our `@source` globs and our `@theme` block to get anything out of it.
//build-tsconfig: esbuild discovers the *root* tsconfig.json on its own, and it honours `paths` — which map @three-studio/* onto sibling source. Without pointing it at the build config, whose `paths` are empty, esbuild inlines core and runtime into every bundle instead of leaving them as the dependencies they are.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --tsconfig=tsconfig.build.json --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2023 --jsx=automatic --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js && tailwindcss -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css --minify

//peerDependencies: react, react-dom and three are peers rather than dependencies. A second React makes hooks throw; a second three makes `instanceof` fail across the boundary. Both are duplicated the moment a consumer already has their own.
